newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cert coffee stocks rise 21,744 bags Dec 20 wk.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cert coffee stocks rise 21,744 bags Dec 20 wk.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks nearly tripled in the week ended December 20, rising 21,744 60-kg bags to 34,315 bags, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said on Monday.
In addition, 250 bags were certified for delivery at New York between December 20 and 23, after the close of the weekly reporting period, bringing the current graded total to 34,565 bags.
There were no bags pending grading in exchange-certified warehouses, the CSCE said.

Most of this week's sharp build occurred in Miami, where stocks of Guatemalan coffee jumped to 17,250 bags, from 12,250 bags a week ago. Inventories of Venezuelan coffees reached 6,000 bags as of December 20.
